what_i_got_wrong: FOUR THINGS, ALL CAUGHT BY RUNNING RATHER THAN READING. (1) I reported the trunk-red test as still failing on the merged tree. Re-run with the bare console script: 113 passed. ⚠ A wrong interpreter and a wrong verdict are indistinguishable from the exit code alone. The finding survives and is worse than I first stated — the handoff's id now resolves confidently to the wrong defect instead of dangling — but the sentence needed correcting, not repeating.
